title: Heroes on their feet
text:
New skeletons with ankles and toes, rebuilt attacks with weapon trails, and more natural movement for every hero.

✨ Rebuilt attacks for every melee hero: each blow winds up, whips through and follows through. The hips turn first, then the chest, then the arm, and the wrist snaps last. The lead foot steps into the blow, and the weapon is aimed so spears and staves thrust level, swords cut on a diagonal and maces come down on the target
✨ Weapon trails: swords, maces, spears, staves and daggers leave a streak of light along their edge through each strike, in each hero's colour (or the weapon's colour for epic and legendary weapons)
• The Bard now fights with big overhead cuts: over the right shoulder, over the left, then straight down
✨ The Barbarian charges: when running he leans in and carries his mace low and forward, ready to swing
✨ The Hunter now carries a longbow (grip toward the target, limbs sweeping back) and shoots like an archer: the bow arm comes up toward the target and the body turns side-on, the arrow is nocked and drawn back to the cheek (you can see the string and arrow pull back), a moment's aim, then the string snaps and the drawing hand flies back. Aimed Shot holds the full draw for the whole cast
✨ Arrows leave a bright streak in flight and strike with a puff of splinters
• Easier clicking: monsters, bosses and players are much easier to select. Each has a larger click area that includes the name plate above it, a click that lands just beside a target still picks it, targets can be clicked from further away, and a click with a little mouse wobble (or a slightly slow tap) still counts as a click instead of turning the camera
✨ Footfalls: every hero's footsteps now land exactly when a heel touches the ground, with a print in snow, sand and ash, a puff of dust or a splash in shallow water, and a heavier thud of dust and water when landing from a jump
🔧 The Bard's and the Celestus' long swords trail back and down while moving instead of dragging through the ground
✨ Your hero's head (and a little of the chest) turns to watch your target. Arms swing with some weight to them, and the shoulders rise and fall with each breath
✨ New skeletons: every hero now has ankles and toes. Feet roll through each step: the heel lands, the foot goes flat, the heel lifts and the toes push off. Runners land on the balls of their feet
✨ Feet stay planted: a foot on the ground stays flat on the ground instead of tilting with the leg, and the swinging foot hangs naturally
✨ Uneven ground: each foot finds the ground under it. On slopes and steps the hips drop, the uphill knee bends and the feet tilt with the slope, so heroes no longer float or sink into hills
✨ Strafing and backing up turn the hips toward the direction of travel while the chest keeps facing forward
✨ Turning on the spot takes small steps instead of sliding round
✨ Footwork in combat: lunging blows lift the back heel, and the fighting stance sits on the balls of the feet. Kneeling rests the back foot on its toes, toes point when jumping and swimming, and heels stay down in the stirrups
🔧 Heroes no longer look like they have extra legs or a second weapon when running: the seams where the pieces of each hero's body meet now hold together instead of tearing open, loose bits of armour stay fastened to the limb they sit on, every point of a weapon (including the separate spikes of the Barbarian's mace head) follows the hand that holds it, and arms that were sculpted resting against the body come away cleanly when raised
🔧 Leg armour that used to hang in the air when a leg swung (the Warden's and Barbarian's knee guards and boot toes) now moves with the leg
